resolution1.title: Resolution 1 — Foiled by Dogs!
resolution1.body: The investigators defeat Meowlathotep and stop the feline plot. Barkham is safe to explore, sniff and enjoy again.

resolution2.title: Resolution 2 — Ancient Hisstory
resolution2.body: The feline conspiracy succeeds before the investigators can stop it. Meowlathotep and the cats claim Barkham.
